# Pin the first baseline and freeze the evaluation protocol

Start with `experiments/000-baseline/plan.md` and the wiki's First-baseline article. The bounded first outcome is a reviewed, immutable protocol and resource estimate before any training.

- [ ] Learner states one prediction in their own words.
- [ ] Resolve the proposed Minikazam starting checkpoint and Kakuna rival to exact upstream revisions, files, SHA-256 hashes, and licenses.
- [ ] Pin Metamon, Showdown, interfaces, dependencies, and inference settings.
- [ ] Freeze Gen 1 OU team/opponent splits, weights, seeds, balanced fixture schedule, battle count, primary metric, uncertainty analysis, stopping rule, and failure/tie rules.
- [ ] Specify standard-timer enforcement and actual decision-latency capture, including deadline misses.
- [ ] State whether an upstream numerical result can be reproduced under matching conditions, or label the first run a new baseline measurement.
- [ ] Record data/model size estimates and a compute budget without large downloads.
- [ ] Commit the protocol, then request separate execution authorization.
- [ ] After authorization, capture a local smoke check and unchanged-checkpoint baseline receipt with logs, hashes, uncertainty, failures, and compute accounting.

Not run. No model downloads, GPU jobs, credentials, account registration, human-ladder play, competition entry, or official-server battles are authorized by this issue. Do not train until the reproduction and protocol are reviewed. Do not move the fixed rival or reuse the final holdout for tuning.
